title: ETL steps survive a dropped connection and retry
goal: Fix the nightly run that failed on 2026-11-12 (run 83e03e43: listing parliament.lk/acts and lankalaw/acts-by-year died when Neon closed the connection the crawl held open), and make Dagster retry a failed step, because that is how workflows run reliably (user).
for_whom: The user, who runs the pipeline from Dagster and should not have to rerun it by hand after a blip.

done_check.check: A listing opens its database connection only after the site is crawled (with the retrying pg_connect), so a long crawl holds no idle connection; a unit test shows the crawl runs before any connect.

Every op in the sllaw_v2 job retries a failure twice, waiting 2 then 4 minutes; the link gold set and quality gate verdict failures (bad data) do not retry. Shown by a test on the job definition and the Failure flags.
The user's rerun from Dagster on ampere finishes with the two listing steps green.

scenarios.steps: Neon drops the connection or DNS blips while a step runs.
scenarios.expect: The step fails once, Dagster retries it after 2 minutes, and the run goes on.

scenarios.steps: The gate finds an error-level issue outside gazettes.
scenarios.expect: The run fails at once, with no retry.

out_of_scope: Retrying inside the other stages' work queue (it already retries items 3 times).

decisions.note: 2 retries, 2 then 4 min, exponential (user). Verdict failures of the checks don't retry (user); crashes, dropped connections and no free GPU for embed do.

progress.note: d1 and d2 built: stages.listing(connect, ...) crawls then connects (test_v2 'ok listing connects after the crawl'); job op_retry_policy RETRY, gold/gate verdicts allow_retries=False (etl.v2.test_pipeline passed in ampere's dagster_venv on a temp copy, deleted). Next: validate, push, d3 is the user's rerun.
